directional_targets: NaP lesion abolishes sustained autonomous firing or approaches silence; no exact residual-rate cutoff is yet source-sealed
Cav2.2 lesion weakens the AHP and elevates spike threshold; baseline-rate direction is not a gate
SK lesion weakens AHP depth and increases irregularity or causes depolarization block; a rate increase is not required

HCN blockade did not show a statistically significant baseline-rate change in the transferred preparation; no equivalence claim is allowed until a margin is preregistered, and hyperpolarization/recovery is assessed separately
inhibition suppresses firing and recovery occurs autonomously without state clear or host current
post-release overshoot remains phase-consistent rather than requiring an intrinsic T-type rebound burst
pallidal barrage generally suppresses less and increases irregularity more than an equal-mean conductance step
